title: disagreeing kindly
subtitle: a different view doesn't have to be a fight

steps.text: having a different opinion doesn't mean starting a fight.

steps.prompt: a friend says something you don't agree with. try each reply on:
lines: i hear you. for me it's more about the cost.
steps.reply: the last two keep it about your view, not their mistake. that's what makes them easier to hear.

steps.text: "i" sentences keep the focus on what you think, instead of what they missed.

options.label: disagreeing at all
options.reply: makes sense. if disagreeing ever caused trouble, of course you got careful.

options.label: staying calm while i do
options.reply: that's really common. a slow breath before you speak helps.

options.label: neither, really
options.reply: nice. then this is just more range.

steps.template: i see it a little differently: {x}
ideas: for me, it's more about time than money.

steps.text: you can disagree and stay kind. "i see it differently" is a full sentence.

source.label: assertive communication, a standard skill in cognitive behavioral therapy

steps.evidence: strong (as part of CBT skills training)

steps.text: the next time you disagree, try starting with "i see it differently".
